narrative: On the plot. The ruled pasteboard by the stage door, scenes divided, the Parliament left off it, the jig at the foot.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood by the door. His name is on the plot as Gaunt.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Read the plot scene by scene.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Named as the king. Not yet in the room's talk.

entities.name: William Sly
entities.context: Named as Mowbray in the lists.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Named at the foot, for the jig.

entities.name: Richard the Second
entities.context: Shown on plot in The pasteboard
